content:
Sending documents over email has been giving me the ick for some time. It's just not secure.


But using Sharepoint gives me worse ick. I diligently change the settings for each share so that only the individual meant to receive the document can see it. Check again. And still, the person at the other end can't open it. 

In Practice Hub, I designed a system that means you can upload documents on your view and your client can download them at their end. Really secure, much better than sending via email. 

You can't share documents with employees using this method, though. And that's been bugging me. There was a tipping point a couple of months ago when an employee got super nasty with me because they couldn't download a recording of a hearing I'd sent them. 

I decided to take ACTION to stop difficult file sharing once and for all! 

So I built Secure Share. It's really simple, employees sign in using their email and a magic code, download, upload. My favourite bit is that you can see exactly when they logged in and hit the download button (no more "but I didn't get the letter"!). 

You can also set access to a period of time of your choosing, and revoke access at any time. 

Have a watch of this funky video (loving the music). 

Rocket the cat insisted that I put some orange cats in it and said he'd bring me a spider while I slept if I didn't. 

We’ve made a fully functional demo account already filled with example clients, cases and documents. No card, no sales call. Just have a look around. Have a look here and you’ll be emailed a link: https://lnkd.in/g2-_Khw2

content:
Wouldn't it be really cool if you could record an employee or client meeting, upload it to your CRM, have it transcribed with the correct names and job titles, sent to the other party to review, sign and comment on and then it auto save to your CRM with an electronic signature. 


I HAVE MADE THIS POSSIBLE! 

Sorry for the caps. But I'm excited. I am shouting about this because it's epic and it exists on Practice Hub. 

Meeting transcription. And attendance notes that very nearly write themselves.

Upload the recording of a hearing or investigation meeting to the case and Practice Hub transcribes it, with each voice separated out.

You match the voices to the people who were in the room, then check the transcript with the audio alongside. Click any timestamp and you hear that exact moment.

Redact what needs redacting (handy for DSARs!). Mark the bits nobody could hear. The original is always kept, so every change is on record.

Then export it to Word and PDF with your branding, straight into the case.

My favourite bit?

You can send it to the employee to confirm. They can listen to the recording while they read, then sign it, sign it with comments or tell you they don't agree. Everything is filed to the case with a proper signature certificate.

No more chasing signed meeting notes by email 🙄

Recordings are processed in the EU, never used to train anyone's AI, and deleted from the transcription service as soon as the transcript comes back. Your client never sees them in their portal either unless you allow them to. 

The attendance notes work from a recording too, or from a Fathom, Teams or Zoom transcript.

It drafts the note in your house style and only records what was actually said. If a deadline was mentioned but never agreed, it tells you so! Click any point and it shows you the exact part of the transcript it came from.

Approve it, and the action points become to-dos in one click.

Standard plans include 10 hours of transcription a month. Team plans get 25 hours, shared across the practice. Free trials get 60 minutes. 

Top-up packs are £5 for 10 hours or £10 for 25 hours if you need more (this is very competitive pricing), and they last a year.

It's in testing now and will be live very soon.

I may have cried a little when the first 16-minute recording came back transcribed in 48 seconds 😅

Very normal behaviour.

content:
"Just a sec."


I asked a straightforward question in a grievance meeting. There was a pause while they typed. Then out came an answer so smooth...

Beautifully structured. Perfectly calm. About as personal as a press release. 

That kind of polish doesn't happen by accident when it's your own grievance.

So the The HR Vault's grievance procedures have a new line or two. Optional lines.

AI tools are not permitted during a grievance or appeal meeting. If you're asked a question, you answer it yourself. No typing it into a chatbot mid meeting and reading back whatever comes out. The one exception is an AI tool agreed in advance as a reasonable adjustment, arranged with the manager hearing it before the meeting starts.

While I was in there I also capped the written grievance at two pages, with an executive summary if the grievance does need to be longer. I don't need the full written history across 70 pages.

That's what the meeting is for 😅

content:
The Handbook Portal has had a facelift! And isn't she looking gorgeous!


It's not just the outside that's looking better (sooo much more modern!) but also under the bonnet. No more faffing around with individual uploads. 

Now? Word in, handbook out. Upload the whole handbook and the Portal will pop the policies into sections for you. 

Client logo, colours, fonts, even the favicon, right down to the sign in page. The colours lift themselves straight off the logo, which feels like magic every time!

Every client gets their own web address. Branded PDFs including single policies or the full handbook with a cover, contents page and page numbers. The PDF output is absolutely beautiful, and that's the bit that's taken the time! 

Staff acknowledge each policy and you'll get automatic reminders plus a one click nudge for the stragglers. 

Version history means updates go out by email and you can ask for a fresh acknowledgement whenever the policy changes.

Two ways in, individual logins or one shared password, whichever suits the client. Your client admins can invite staff, upload updates and tweak branding themselves, within whatever limits you set.

Groups mean not every policy goes to every team. Search, mobile friendly, an activity log for everything.
